parameters.body:
=SELECT *
FROM n8n_olap.fact_exchange_index_histories
WHERE time = '{{ $json.trade_date }}'
AND index_id IN ('VN30', 'VNINDEX')
FORMAT JSON;

=SELECT *
FROM n8n_olap.fact_market_regime_histories
WHERE time = '{{ $json.trade_date }}'
FORMAT JSON;

=SELECT 
    symbol as stock_key,
    trade_date as date_key,
    sma_20_slope_k1,
    sma_20_slope_k5,
    sma_50_slope_k1,
    sma_50_slope_k5,
    signal_crossover_sma_20_50,
    signal_crossover_sma_50_100,
    expected_return_t2_n20,
    volatility_t2_n20,
    rsi_7,
    rsi_14,
    signal_volume_outlier,
    pivot_s1_plus_1,
    days_since_volume_outlier
FROM n8n_olap.v_analytics_master_consolidated
WHERE date_key = '{{ ($json && $json.trade_date) ? $json.trade_date : new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0] }}' 
    AND signal_crossover_sma_50_100 >= 0
    AND rsi_14 BETWEEN 30 AND 70
    AND volume >= 50000
    AND sma_50_slope_k1 >= 0
    AND sma_20_slope_k1 >= 0
    AND sma_20_slope_k5 >= 0
    AND sma_50_slope_k5 >= 0
    AND volatility_t2_n20 BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.05
    AND expected_return_t2_n20 BETWEEN 0.002 AND 0.055
    AND rsi_7 BETWEEN 40 AND 85
    AND signal_crossover_sma_20_50 >= 0
    AND signal_volume_outlier = 0
    AND close >= 15
    AND days_since_volume_outlier >= 4
ORDER BY 
    expected_return_t2_n20 DESC,
    stock_key ASC,
    date_key ASC,
    sma_20_slope_k1 ASC,
    sma_20_slope_k5 ASC,
    sma_50_slope_k1 ASC,
    sma_50_slope_k5 ASC,
    signal_crossover_sma_20_50 ASC,
    signal_crossover_sma_50_100 ASC,
    volatility_t2_n20 ASC,
    rsi_7 ASC,
    rsi_14 ASC,
    signal_volume_outlier ASC,
    days_since_volume_outlier ASC
LIMIT 501 FORMAT JSON;

parameters.query:
=-- Retrieve all orders and their corresponding items for a specific local date
SELECT
    o.account_id,
    o.trade_date,
    o.trade_type,
    o.created_at,
    oi.symbol,
    oi.quantity,
    oi.price,
    oi.total_amount
FROM orders AS o
INNER JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON o.account_id = oi.account_id
    AND o.trade_date = oi.trade_date
    AND o.trade_type = oi.trade_type
WHERE o.trade_date = '{{ $json.trade_date }}'
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.account_id, oi.symbol;

=SELECT *
FROM n8n_olap.corporate_actions
WHERE ex_rights_date > addDays(toDate('{{ ($json && $json.trade_date) ? String($json.trade_date).slice(0, 10) : $now.setZone("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh").toFormat("yyyy-MM-dd") }}'), 1)
ORDER BY ex_rights_date ASC
FORMAT JSON;
